# Data types

Components exchange typed values defined as [Pydantic](https://docs.pydantic.dev)
models in `oedisi.types.data_types`. A port's `type` in a
`component_definition.json` refers to one of the models below. Many concrete
types are thin subclasses that inherit their fields from a base array type.

(datatype-equipmentnodearray)=
### EquipmentNodeArray

Inherits [`MeasurementArray`](#datatype-measurementarray).

Primary key is ids + equipment_ids.

- ids corresponding node id, so "113.1", "113.2", "113.3"
- equipment_id corresponds to PVSystem.113

Extended by classes:
    "PowersMagnitude",
    "PowersAngle",
    "PowersReal",
    "PowersImaginary",

**Fields**

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `equipment_ids` | `List[str]` | **required** |  |
